description: EnergyDataModel is a Rebase Energy Python package for representing energy assets and system relationships. Its classes describe graph nodes, edges, collections and physical equipment, with stable identifiers, optional geometry and attached time-series metadata. Users can assemble asset hierarchies and export representations such as CSV, JSON and GeoJSON. Technology-specific classes include solar, wind and grid equipment, and an optional solar package supports conversion to pvlib objects. Coverage and asset detail are defined by the user's system; the package does not provide a complete geographic network or observation period. Public source and installation documentation are free under MIT. A material limitation is that attached time-series objects are typically declarations of available series, not the measurements themselves. Conversion to an external energy model also depends on the implemented adapter and optional dependencies. The package can prepare consistent asset descriptions for energy simulation and data exchange. It serves a preparation role alongside power-network models such as pandapower (model-pandapower), but a tested pandapower adapter was not established in the inspected README.
